title: Progress Lighthouse — 1:1 Prep & Action Tracker (Jordan Lyon)
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Aisha (manager) — prep notes
Date: 2026-09-08, 10:30am
Location: Zoom / async summary in Slack #eng-serving-runtime
Goal: align on recent rollout, surface risks for next sprint, and calibrate growth plan for Q4 promo window.

Top-line updates (2 minutes each)
- Rollout status: canary 25% on v2.3.1 (quantized path). No major errors; small tail-latency regressions observed during long-context traces.
- Throughput: p95 tokens/sec down 6% on medium prompts vs baseline; investigating kernel selection path.
- Oncall: I handled incident 2026-09-03 (cold-start amplification) — postmortem draft linked.

Discussion agenda (priority order)
1) Latency regression root-cause hypothesis (15 mins)
   - Data points: traces show KV-cache miss rate spikes for seq>2048; kernel fallback to non-fused matmul.
   - Ask Aisha: permission to allocate 2 dedicated test GPUs for profiling for 5 working days (cost tradeoff).
   - Decide: quick mitigation (restrict long-context to compatible model variants) vs deeper kernel fix timeline.

2) Dedicated capacity autoscaling policy tweak (10 mins)
   - Proposal: add a soft cap pre-warm threshold to reduce cold-starts for reserved pools after idle > 30m.
   - Need product/product-ops signoff; quick prototype could be done in sprint if we reprioritize one ticket.

3) Career checkpoint / growth goals (10 mins)
   - My ask: clear path to Sr. EM IC+ by end of Q4; want to own one cross-team reliability project and mentor 2 engineers.
   - Evidence to present: incident leadership, rollout ownership, mentoring hours logged (link to spreadsheet).
   - Ask for explicit success criteria and timeline.

4) Follow-ups & blockers (5 mins)
   - Blocker: blocked by infra quota for private-debug cluster (ticket INF-570).
   - Blocker: needing design review for KV-cache interface change (PR #412 needs eng-arch review).

Quick notes to bring up informally
- Feeling stretched: ~55h last 2 weeks; need to reprioritize noncritical refactor (list tasks under parking lot).
- Pep talk: ask for coaching on delegation — help identify two tasks to hand off to Samir.

Action items (owner -> due)
- Jordan: share profiling traces + synthesized hypothesis doc with Aisha and eng-arch (due 2026-09-10).
- Aisha: approve budget for 2 test GPUs or suggest alternative (due 2026-09-09).
- Jordan -> Infra: escalates INF-570 with SRE lead, include 'test cluster' label (due 2026-09-09).
- Samir: pick up frontend-ready refactor (parking lot) and mentor plan check-in (Jordan to handoff by 2026-09-12).
- Eng-Arch (TBD): review PR #412 and give design feedback (requested by 2026-09-14).

Parking lot / notes to self
- Draft language for promotion case: 3 bullets showing impact (reliability SLO improvement, cost savings from caching, leadership in cross-team rollout).
- Compile mentoring log: dates, sessions, topics — add to shared spreadsheet.
- Revisit batching config experiment: run on a small fleet target to validate unit-cost improvement (~10–12%).

Open questions to get Aisha's guidance on
- Is taking the hit of 2 GPUs for profiling acceptable given current cost center? (If no, propose staged profiling on spot instances.)
- What level of evidence is enough to move forward with kernel changes vs. temporary routing rule?
- How visible should my mentoring contribution be — can we add it to team OKRs?

Post-meeting follow-up plan
- Send an async summary in Slack w/ action items and links (I will ping SRE and eng-arch).
- Update personal tracker and promotion doc (add measurable outcomes).
- Schedule a 30-min deep-dive with eng-arch if they can't resolve within 1 week.

Quick references
- Incident postmortem: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-09-03
- PR for cache change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412
- Jira: RINF-2381 (latency investigations), INF-570 (private test cluster)

Scratch thoughts (raw)
- Could we do a tiny A/B that routes long-context -> non-quantized variant to see effect? cheap and reversible.
- Consider temporary TTL-based cache warmup for largest-key prefixes.
- Keep promotion doc focused: metrics + narratives + sponsor quotes.

End of prep.

-- Jordan
